How to use this page. Judge every icon with the four buttons on each card: ✓ keep · ✎ needs correction · ✕ drop/bad · ⎘ looks copied. Your marks save to this browser automatically. When you are done hit Export review and paste the result back to me — I will action it and wire the survivors into DisplayPresentation/VectorCodec.cpp.

On originality. Every glyph was diffed against 2,125 reference icons (1,838 Lucide + 287 Feather) on four measures: coordinate-pair overlap, command fingerprint, 64×64 rendered-pixel IoU, and longest verbatim path run. Hover any badge for its numbers. A REVIEW badge with coord 0 · verb 0 means the outline converges on a universal symbol (a chevron is a chevron) while sharing zero coordinate data — turn on Compare to see both side by side and decide for yourself.
